title: 船舶分段建造
summary: 以分段接合數位模型串起基準、尺寸、熱變形與品質記錄，讓學員看見誤差如何累積。 在船廠分段裝配數位工坊依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Connect datums, dimensions, thermal distortion and quality records in a block-assembly model to reveal error accumulation. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Ship-block assembly digital workshop. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 分段共同座標與誤差鏈：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 分段共同座標與誤差鏈 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Common coordinates and tolerance chain and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶分段建造」的「分段共同座標與誤差鏈」中，獨立隨機公差可按平方和估計，但有界最差情境需相加。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：以分段接合數位模型串起基準、尺寸、熱變形與品質記錄，讓學員看見誤差如何累積。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ship block construction, Common coordinates and tolerance chain examines this mechanism: Independent random tolerances may combine by RSS; bounded worst cases add directly. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Connect datums, dimensions, thermal distortion and quality records in a block-assembly model to reveal error accumulation.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：獨立標準差 0.8、0.6、0.3 mm。關係式 u=√Σuᵢ²；含單位換算算式 (0.8**2+0.6**2+0.3**2)**0.5 = 1.04403065 mm。適用條件：假設獨立且使用標準差，不是最大允許偏差。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Independent standard deviations 0.8, 0.6 and 0.3 mm. Relation u=√Σuᵢ²; expression including unit conversion (0.8**2+0.6**2+0.3**2)**0.5 = 1.04403065 mm. Applicability: Assumes independence and standard deviations, not maximum permitted deviations.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：同一量具偏置不可藉多次拼接平方和消除。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: A common gauge bias cannot disappear through RSS stacking. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「分段共同座標與誤差鏈」，與完全正相關時的標準差算術和比較；真正最差界限須另給有界公差。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Common coordinates and tolerance chain, Compare with the arithmetic sum of standard deviations for full positive correlation; a true worst-case bound requires separate bounded tolerances. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「船舶分段建造」的「分段共同座標與誤差鏈：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「船塢學院：一艘模型的交付」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Common coordinates and tolerance chain: Mechanism and observation” in “Ship block construction”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Dockyard Academy: Deliver a Scale Model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instruction: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：不同時間窗或乾濕基準相減會製造虛假質量殘差。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.instructionEn: First examine this alternative cause: Subtracting different time windows or dry/wet bases creates false mass residuals. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：鋼材入料1000 kg、已裝配850 kg、可追溯邊料50 kg。關係式 mass residual = total − accounted contribution 1 − accounted contribution 2；含單位換算算式 1000-850-50 = 100 kg。適用條件：獨立質量帳；同一時間窗、相同物質邊界與一致乾濕基準。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Steel input 1000 kg, assembled material 850 kg and traced offcuts 50 kg. Relation mass residual = total − accounted contribution 1 − accounted contribution 2; expression including unit conversion 1000-850-50 = 100 kg. Applicability: Independent mass ledger with one time window, material boundary and consistent dry/wet basis.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：不同時間窗或乾濕基準相減會製造虛假質量殘差。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Subtracting different time windows or dry/wet bases creates false mass residuals. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「鋼料進出與分段重量」，逐一核對秤重時間、批次、庫存變化和乾濕基準，列出尚未歸帳項目。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Steel flow and block mass, Check weighing times, batches, inventory changes and dry/wet basis; list unaccounted items. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.title: 鋼料進出與分段重量
knowledge.text: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：不同時間窗或乾濕基準相減會製造虛假質量殘差。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
knowledge.textEn: First examine this alternative cause: Subtracting different time windows or dry/wet bases creates false mass residuals. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「鋼料進出與分段重量」比較基準算式 1000-850-50 與替代算式 1000-820-50。先圈出唯一變動的輸入並預測增減，再計算 130 kg，與基準 100 kg 比較。保存輸入、單位、兩個輸出與一項不能外推的結論；只在數位模型或紙上進行。
knowledge.textEn: For Steel flow and block mass, compare baseline expression 1000-850-50 with alternative 1000-820-50. Identify the single changed input and predict direction before calculating 130 kg, versus baseline 100 kg. Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.
